title: Code and processed data for: Characterizing Variants of Uncertain Drug Response (VUDRs) Using Quantitative Measurements at Clinical Exposures
description: Analysis code and processed data for the manuscript Characterizing Variants of Uncertain Drug Response (VUDRs) Using Quantitative Measurements at Clinical Exposures (Inam, Tomaszkiewicz et al.). The repository contains R code for processing BCR-ABL kinase-domain deep mutational scanning (DMS) data (variant calling, net growth rate estimation, regression correction against mutant standards, concentration-response fitting and logistic-regression resistance classification at clinical imatinib exposures), together with the scripts, inputs and outputs used to generate every figure panel and supplementary table. See README.md for a figure-to-code map. Raw sequencing reads are available at NCBI SRA under BioProject PRJNA1279649.
